methodology.analysis_scope: Airtable Airlines and Events tables only; signal-feed data is not used.
methodology.duplicate_airlines: Exact airline names are deduplicated. Newest Last Modified row wins; blank fields fall back to older nonblank values.
methodology.fleet_bands: Small 1-50; Medium 51-150; Large 151+. Values above 1,500 are flagged as needing verification and excluded from size means.
methodology.carrier_types: ULCC labels are grouped with LCC. Optional exact-name overrides apply updated Airtable Airline Type labels.
methodology.headquarters: Optional exact-name HQ overrides fill confirmed missing headquarters values before country and region mapping.
methodology.conference_dates: Optional exact-name end-date overrides resolve confirmed Airtable date errors without changing the source export.
methodology.eff_and_planning: Only recorded Airtable values are counted. Blank fields are missing coverage, not evidence of no adoption.
methodology.conference_priority: Historical conference records are summarized with linked-airline counts. Counts are coverage signals, not measured event ROI.
